title: feat: C_DeriveKey ECDH for PIV 9D slot and soft token
description: C_DeriveKey with CKM_ECDH1_DERIVE is the PKCS#11 mechanism for ECDH key agreement. The PIV slot 9D (key management) is specifically designated for this operation; without C_DeriveKey, slot 9D is dead code and wolfP11 cannot support TLS client-side key exchange, ECIES, or encrypted key transport protocols. This epic implements CKM_ECDH1_DERIVE for the PIV backend via the GENERAL AUTHENTICATE APDU in key-agreement mode, and for the soft backend via wc_ecc_shared_secret, returning the derived shared secret as a CKO_SECRET_KEY.
